alternative_interpretations: The scene may simply depict routine animal husbandry without symbolic intent.
limitations: No signage, labels, or explicit contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; interpretation relies on visual analogy alone.

limitations: The human’s posture, gaze direction, and attention are indiscernible; no interaction is visible.
